question: Which SAI venue in Chennai was scheduled to host the Athletics selection trials on 1 February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium** in **Chennai** was the designated venue for the **Athletics selection trials** conducted by the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** on **1 February 2025**.
 
• These trials are primarily conducted to identify and induct talented young sportspersons into the **SAI Training Centre (STC)** scheme for the academic session **2025-26**.
 
• The **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**, also known as the **JLN Stadium**, is a premier multi-purpose sports facility in **Tamil Nadu**, featuring a high-quality **8-lane synthetic athletics track** that meets international standards.
 
• The selection process is typically aimed at athletes in the age group of **12 to 18 years**, evaluating their performance across various disciplines such as **sprints, middle-distance running, jumps, and throws**.
